structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a fresh PWEASE copy, about 35 minutes old, launched on a Meteora virtual curve and already migrated to PumpSwap. Its linked X handle is @JDVance and its website is a UsePaid profile (usepaid.app/profile/jdvance). UsePaid is a service that sends creator fees to an X user, so the link to Vance is almost certainly not something he authorised. At least 8 same-name PWEASE tokens launched within minutes of each other, which points to a burst of JD Vance "pwease" attention right now. The original PWEASE (CniPCE…pump, about $4.5M market cap, famous since Decrypt covered it spiking when Vance posted the meme) is still the canonical token. This coin briefly led the new copies: about 2,100 unique buyers in the first half hour and ~$730k of volume. It then fell hard: -62% in 30 minutes and about -88% from its all-time-high price (0.00123 down to 0.00014). Unique buyers in the last 30 minutes were only 87, against 91 sellers.

narrative.description: The JD Vance "pwease and tank you" meme (from the Zelenskyy meeting). It is a durable, well-known political meme with an established canonical token. Merchandise shows the meme is still circulating in Sept 2026. I could not confirm what triggered today's burst, possibly a new Vance post.
narrative.why_spreading: Several same-name launches at once suggest an off-chain trigger, likely a Vance post or mention that I could not verify. Attention on this particular copy peaked in its first ~10 minutes and is now fading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was the highest-cap and highest-volume of today's new copies. It is also a UsePaid launch paying fees to @JDVance, which may make it look like the 'official' fresh copy.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The canonical CniPCE…pump PWEASE ($4.5M cap, $960k liquidity). Also 6ExhLZ… ($103k, $771k h1 volume, same creation time) and 8TP6x…pump ($42k, $413k h1 volume), plus several smaller copies.

authenticity.evidence: About 2,100 unique buyers, but almost all bought in the first ~30 minutes. GMGN flags 29 bundler wallets and a 9% top bundler/trader share. No paid DexScreener boosts. The @JDVance link is borrowed, not an endorsement.
authenticity.uncertainty: I found no X posts about this contract and could not see what triggered the launches.

structural_risks: Liquidity is only $27k against a $141k market cap
RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked (GMGN reports the LP burn ratio as 1, which conflicts)
One holder has 80% of supply (probably the curve or pool account, not confirmed)
It is a copycat of a verified token, so it competes with 8+ clones
Price has collapsed about 88% from its all-time high, which leaves a large pool of trapped sellers above

structured_output.counterargument: If Vance or a big account keeps pushing "pwease" today, the fee-to-@JDVance angle could make this the go-to fresh copy. It still has about 2,000 holders, and a bounce from -88% could easily reach 2x from a low entry.
unknowns: What triggered today's wave of copies
Whether the 80% holder is the pool or a single wallet
Whether @JDVance or anyone notable referenced this contract
Why the LP lock data disagrees between sources

source_coverage.notes: The contract search returned nothing. News covers the original PWEASE and the Vance meme. The UsePaid profile fetch failed with an SSL error. I skipped Reddit, Telegram and Discord because of time.

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical clone of a known Vance meme coin, now dumping hard after a first-30-minute buyer surge. New buyers have dried up and it competes with many clones and the $4.5M original. Low odds of a 2x from here.
